title: Facet force at L3-L4 - Wilson DC, Niosi CA, Zhu QA, Oxland TR, Wilson DR 2006 (J Biomech 39:348) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet force
quantity.definition: min/max contact force between left and right facets (pressure-sensitive film)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.n: not stated in review (see primary: Wilson DC, Niosi CA, Zhu QA, Oxland TR, Wilson DR 2006 (J Biomech 39:348))
source.sample: human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Wilson DC, Niosi CA, Zhu QA, Oxland TR, Wilson DR 2006 (J Biomech 39:348), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm; Tekscan film. Cross-check: Dreischarf 2014 Fig 2c red ranges digitised as 10-50 N (extension) and 54-109 N (AR), consistent.
how_to_simulate: Apply 7.5 Nm pure moment in extension and axial rotation
Report L3-L4 facet contact force (left and right)
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (the user's own review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Wilson DC, Niosi CA, Zhu QA, Oxland TR, Wilson DR 2006 (J Biomech 39:348).

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
